backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the grocery store backend, defining data types and CRUD operations for products, orders, carts, bills, recharge orders, and user profiles, with role-based access control and blob storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping two implemented features—checkout delivery charge breakdown and 'Delivery in 10 Mins' product card label—to their source files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-sentence summaries of every frontend source file, describing the purpose and recent changes of each component, page, and hook in the React app.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining CSS custom property design tokens for light and dark themes including colors, radius, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML shell for the Maa Bhawani General Store PWA, including viewport meta tags, PWA manifest link, Apple touch icon, Google Fonts (Inter), and the React root mount point.
frontend/public/manifest.json: PWA web app manifest for Maa Bhawani General Store defining app name, icons, theme colors, display mode, and start URL.
frontend/public/service-worker.js: Service worker implementing cache-first strategy for static assets and network-first strategy for API calls, with install/activate lifecycle handlers for cache versioning.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with all application routes including home, checkout, order confirmation, store details, admin dashboard, billing, and admin settings pages.
frontend/src/components/AdminGuard.tsx: A route guard component that protects admin pages by checking for a valid hardcoded-credential session (stored in localStorage) and verifying the caller is an admin via a backend query. Displays login dialog, loading states, and access-denied UI as appropriate.
frontend/src/components/AdminProductForm: A form component for adding new products to the store, supporting fields like name, category, price, unit type, barcode (with scanner), stock quantity, and image upload with progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/AdminProductList: Displays a table of all products with inline stock editing, low-stock warnings, and delete confirmation dialogs, using backend queries for data fetching and mutations.
frontend/src/components/BarcodeScanner.t: A camera-based barcode scanner component that loads Quagga2 from CDN, handles camera permissions, flash toggling, scan cooldown, beep/haptic feedback, and returns scanned barcodes via a callback.
frontend/src/components/BillHistoryTable: Renders a searchable table of past bills with options to view, print, or export them as CSV, using a dialog with BillTemplate for bill preview/printing.
frontend/src/components/BillTemplate.tsx: Renders a printable receipt/bill template for Maa Bhawani General Store, displaying bill number, date, customer info, itemized table, and total amount with a shop slogan fetched from the backend.
frontend/src/components/CallUsButton.tsx: A fixed floating action button in the bottom-right corner that links to a phone call via a tel: href.
frontend/src/components/CartDrawer.tsx: A slide-out sheet drawer displaying the user's shopping cart with quantity controls, item removal, cart clearing, and a checkout button that checks shop open status before navigating.
frontend/src/components/CategoryFilter.t: A horizontally scrollable row of buttons for filtering products by category, highlighting the currently selected category.
A static informational alert component that displays the store's delivery fee policy (free above ₹51 within 1km, ₹5 below, ₹20/km beyond).
frontend/src/components/ErrorBoundary.ts: A React class-based error boundary that catches rendering errors and displays an error message with stack trace details and options to retry or go home.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer displaying store name, contact info (phone and Google Maps link), delivery info, and a copyright notice with a caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky top navigation header with the store logo, shop open/closed status indicator, admin dashboard link, cart icon with item count badge, and login/logout button using Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Root layout wrapper that composes the Header, Footer, and CallUsButton around page content, and prefetches shop open status to avoid banner flashing.
frontend/src/components/MobileRechargeSe: A form component for placing mobile recharge orders, supporting Indian operators (Airtel, Jio, etc.) with validation for phone number, operator selection, and amount, using the `usePlaceRechargeOrder` mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/PaymentQRCode.ts: Displays a UPI payment QR code image along with the payment amount and step-by-step instructions for completing payment via UPI apps.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Renders a single product card with image, category/unit badges, price, and add-to-cart functionality, supporting both unit-based and weight-based (grams/kg) quantity input.
frontend/src/components/ProductGrid.tsx: Fetches and displays all products in a responsive grid with category filtering via `CategoryFilter`, showing skeletons while loading.
frontend/src/components/ShopClosedBanner: Shows an alert banner indicating the shop is closed with reopening hours, only rendered after shop status is confirmed closed via `useGetShopOpenStatus`.
frontend/src/components/ShopClosedChecko: Displays an alert dialog when the shop transitions from open to closed during a session, redirecting the user to the home page on acknowledgment.
frontend/src/components/ShopStatusToggle: Admin UI card that shows the current shop open/closed status and provides a button to toggle it using `useSetShopOpenStatus`.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an ICP backend actor instance based on the current Internet Identity, initializing admin access control if a token is present, and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an `InternetIdentityProvider` context and `useInternetIdentity` hook for managing ICP Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and identity persistence via `AuthClient`.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend interactions including products, cart, orders, recharge orders, bills, and shop settings using TanStack Query's useQuery and useMutation.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserProfile.ts: Empty file with no content, likely a placeholder for a user profile hook.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind, defines light/dark theme CSS variables, touch-friendly utilities, thermal printer print styles, and a barcode scanner laser animation.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard page with tabbed navigation for managing products, orders, recharge requests, and bills, including order status progression controls.
frontend/src/pages/AdminSettingsPage.tsx: Admin settings page that allows editing the shop slogan with a live bill preview, protected by AdminGuard.
frontend/src/pages/BillingPage.tsx: Admin billing page that supports barcode scanning (camera or manual) to add products to a bill, manage quantities, and generate printable bills for customers.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx: Customer checkout page that collects delivery details, calculates total price based on distance, and places an order with UPI or COD payment method selection.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Renders the store home page with a banner image, shop closed notice, mobile recharge section, and a product grid.
frontend/src/pages/OrderConfirmationPage: Displays order confirmation details (order ID, payment method) after checkout, showing either a UPI QR code or a cash-on-delivery notice based on the stored payment method.
frontend/src/pages/StoreDetailsPage.tsx: Shows store information including contact number, location map link, delivery policy, hours, and an embedded Google Maps iframe.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage fallback support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom OKLCH-based color tokens, border radii, fonts, shadows, and accordion animations, with typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks the project's current state including existing features, pending feature requests (wallet system, delivery charge logic, product labels), known issues, and architectural constraints for Maa Bhawani General Store.
